textTemplates.name: AddDebitsToScheduleContent
textTemplates.text: Add Debits to Schedule: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello. The client is enrolled with us for {!Get_Program_Plan.Payment_Term__c} months, and it appears their schedule is approaching its end. I want to make sure that their debit schedule is being followed according to the terms of the contract. Please add any necessary debits to align with the client's program term. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: CancellationContent
textTemplates.text: Cancellation : {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please cancel the client’s [SAS/RAM] account due to {!Cancellation_Reason}. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: DiscontinuedCitadelFeeContent
textTemplates.text: Discontinued Citadel Fee: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please note that the client referenced above has successfully completed all fee payments and no longer requires services from Citadel. Kindly ensure that the monthly membership fee is discontinued, as the client no longer needs legal support. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: DPS_Content
textTemplates.text: Double Payment Request: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please modify debit for {!DPS_Amount} as a double payment. Please modify and adjust. Thank you.

textTemplates.name: PMR_Content
textTemplates.text: Payment Modification / Redraft: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Could you please update the debit number to be scheduled for {!PMR_ScheduleDate_Formula}? Thank you!

textTemplates.name: PR_Content
textTemplates.text: Payment Redraft: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Could you please schedule a debit for {!PR_ScheduleDate_Forumula} to cover the NSF? Thank you!

textTemplates.name: ProgramExtensionContent
textTemplates.text: Program Extension: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello. I’ve spoken with the client regarding his program extension, and he has agreed to proceed. This will allow us to continue negotiations and work towards settling his account. Please see attached the client’s approval to move forward with Program Extension. Please go ahead with the extension and let me know if there’s anything further you need from my side. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: PS_Content
textTemplates.text: Payment Schedule: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please schedule a debit for {!PS_Amount} on {!PS_ScheduleDate} in order to be able to negotiate and settle. Once the payment has been scheduled, kindly confirm so we can verify on our end. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: PSM_Content
textTemplates.text: Payment Schedule Modification: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please modify the client’s debit schedule to be scheduled on {!Schedule_On} to be debited out of his account on {!Schedule_On}. Please modify. Thank you.

textTemplates.name: RefundContent
textTemplates.text: Refund : {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Kindly refund the amount to the client’s [SAS/RAM] account. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: SkipPaymentContent
WireConfirmationAndSPContent
textTemplates.text: Wire Confirmation / Skip Payment Request: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please be informed that the client above has sent in a wire to allocate the “$995” to Citadel to hire legal. Please proceed to skip debit #. Thank you!

textTemplates.name: WireConfirmationContent
textTemplates.text: Wire Confirmation: {!Get_Account.Name} {!ProcessorId} Hello, Please be informed that the client above has sent in a wire to allocate the funds to {!WireConfirmationDraft}. Please allocate accordingly. Thank you
